title: What's New: Demo Data for Analytics (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction to Enhanced Demo Data for Analytics
New Demo Data for Sales and Purchasing Documents
Demo Data Expansion Numbers and Continuous Investment

features.name: Enhanced Demo Data Tool for Analytics
features.description: New demo data package for the Contoso demo data tool designed specifically for analytics and reporting use cases. Includes new document types with meaningful variation across time, categories, and salespeople.
caveats: Requires explicit selection when installing new company
Optional component separate from core setup

features.name: Sales Documents Demo Data
features.description: New demo data expanded for sales quotes (18 records, up from 2), blanket sales orders (4 new), posted sales invoices (increased from 80), and return orders (newly available).

features.name: Purchasing Documents Demo Data
features.description: New demo data for purchase orders and posted purchase orders, with counts doubled from 14 to 29 records.

features.name: Analytics Package Installation
features.description: Demo data available through Contoso demo tool package called 'analytics' or automatically included when spinning up new company with all demo data selected.

features.name: Continued Demo Data Investment
features.description: Plans to continue enhancing demo data in future release waves with both new entity types and greater variation in attributes and data distribution.
features.status_evidence_quote: Um and we will continue that investments in the next release wave both like more types of demo data and more types of entities

features.name: Contoso Coffee Open-Source Project
features.description: Demo data tool available as open-source project allowing community contributions and extensions for demo data and analytics.
